metadata.name: laterite
metadata.description: Non-custodial autopilot that turns a capped slice of every payday into tokenized S&P 500.

instructions.name: accept_admin
docs: Second step: the proposed admin signs to take over.

instructions.name: attest
docs: Adds what the user's rule derives from an attested transfer to their pending amount, once per transfer. The
previous instruction must be the ed25519 precompile verifying the attestor's signature over the attestation
for this deployment. Anyone can submit it; the payer funds the record and gets it back on close.

instructions.name: change_payment_tokens
docs: Changes the enabled payment tokens: ends a dropped token's subscription at once, the vault signing as the
plans' owner, and requires a live subscription to the tier's plan for an added one. An added token credits
only transfers from then on; the day's sweeps stay spent.

instructions.name: change_tier
docs: Moves the user to another weekly tier: ends each current subscription at once, the vault signing as the plans'
owner, and requires a live subscription to the new tier's plan for each enabled payment token. The week's
spending carries over, so a change never grants a second cap in one week.

instructions.name: close_attestation
docs: Closes an expired attestation record, refunding its payer. Anyone can call it.

instructions.name: create_plan
docs: Publishes a payment token's weekly tier as a Subscriptions plan owned by the vault authority, paying only into
the swap authority's accounts; the admin pays its rent, which is not refundable.

instructions.name: enroll
docs: Creates the user's settings; the configured sponsor pays the rent. Remaining accounts: the user's
subscription to the chosen tier for each enabled payment token, in token order.

instructions.name: exit
docs: Leaves Laterite: ends each subscription at once, the vault signing as the plans' owner, frees the beta seat,
discards the pending amount and clears the settings. The account and its counters stay, so a return through
`reactivate` grants no new trial, week or sweep day.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Creates the config; only the program's upgrade authority can call it, once. Remaining accounts: the
tables' mint accounts in order, the assets then the payment tokens.

instructions.name: lower_pending
docs: Lowers the user's pending amount to any smaller value, 0 included; it can never raise it.

instructions.name: propose_admin
docs: First step of an admin handover; `Pubkey::default()` cancels a pending one.

instructions.name: reactivate
docs: Returns a user who exited, with new settings, under enrollment's checks; the configured sponsor signs. Credits
only transfers from the reactivation on. Remaining accounts: the user's subscription to the chosen tier for each
enabled payment token, in token order.

instructions.name: set_market_calendar
docs: Replaces the NYSE calendar the weekly engine follows: full-day holidays and 13:00 early closes, each
ascending, as days since 1970-01-01, and the last day the calendar covers.

instructions.name: set_paused
docs: Kill switch: stops enrollment, reactivation and sweeps while set; the users' own controls keep working.

instructions.name: set_user_paused
docs: Pauses an active user or resumes a paused one. Nothing is pulled or credited while paused, and a resumed user
is credited only for transfers from the resume on.

instructions.name: sweep
docs: Invests what is due for one user and payment token, once per UTC day. Verifies the Pyth Pro updates by CPI:
`asset_message` for the asset and, for a payment token with a price feed, `payment_message`, signature entries
0 and 1 of the ed25519 instruction at `ed25519_index`. Pulls through the user's subscription, swaps through
the configured router with the caller's `route` data and the remaining accounts, and checks that the user
received at least the minimum the prices allow. Anyone can call it.

accounts.name: crank
docs: Pays the fees and Pyth Pro's verification fee.

instructions.name: update_config
docs: Replaces the settings: attestor, sponsor and beta caps. The router and the tables are fixed at `initialize`.

instructions.name: update_settings
docs: Replaces the user's asset, engine, rules, cushions and goal; the tier and the payment tokens change through
their own instructions. A rule turned on or a larger multiplier credits only transfers from then on.

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority
errors.msg: Only the program's upgrade authority can initialize the config

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Only the admin can do this

errors.name: NotPendingAdmin
errors.msg: The signer is not the pending admin

errors.name: InvalidRouter
errors.msg: The router is not set, or is not the configured one

errors.name: InvalidAttestor
errors.msg: The attestor key is not set

errors.name: InvalidCap
errors.msg: Caps must be greater than zero

errors.name: InvalidAsset
errors.msg: An asset entry does not match its mint account or has no price feed

errors.name: InvalidPaymentToken
errors.msg: A payment-token entry does not match its mint account

errors.name: InvalidSponsor
errors.msg: The sponsor key is not set

errors.name: ProgramPaused
errors.msg: The program is paused

errors.name: BetaFull
errors.msg: The beta is full

errors.name: UnknownPaymentToken
errors.msg: Not one of the configured payment tokens

errors.name: InvalidTier
errors.msg: Not one of the weekly tiers

errors.name: CapAboveBetaLimit
errors.msg: The tier is above the beta's weekly cap

errors.name: UnknownAsset
errors.msg: Not one of the configured assets

errors.name: NoPaymentToken
errors.msg: At least one configured payment token must be enabled

errors.name: InvalidRules
errors.msg: The rules are out of range or invest nothing

errors.name: SubscriptionMismatch
errors.msg: A subscription to the chosen tier is missing for an enabled payment token

errors.name: NotSponsor
errors.msg: Only the configured sponsor can pay for enrollment

errors.name: CalendarNotAscending
errors.msg: Market closures must be strictly ascending

errors.name: ImplausibleMarketDay
errors.msg: A market closure falls on a weekend, on both lists or outside the calendar's window

errors.name: InvalidPriceUpdate
errors.msg: The price update is malformed, or given for a token counted at one dollar

errors.name: PriceUnavailable
errors.msg: The price update has no usable price for the feed

errors.name: StalePrice
errors.msg: The price is too old

errors.name: PriceUncertain
errors.msg: The price's confidence interval is too wide

errors.name: AmountTooSmall
errors.msg: The amount buys less than one raw unit of the asset

errors.name: InvalidGenesisHash
errors.msg: The cluster's genesis hash is not set

errors.name: InvalidAttestationSignature
errors.msg: The previous instruction is not the attestor's signature over this attestation for this deployment

errors.name: InvalidAttestation
errors.msg: The attestation has no amount or its transfer is outside the user's window

errors.name: UserNotActive
errors.msg: The user is paused or has exited

errors.name: AttestationExpired
errors.msg: The attested transfer is too old

errors.name: NothingToInvest
errors.msg: The user's rules invest nothing for this transfer

errors.name: AttestationNotExpired
errors.msg: The attestation record has not expired yet

errors.name: AlreadySwept
errors.msg: This payment token was already swept today

errors.name: NothingToSweep
errors.msg: Nothing is due for this payment token

errors.name: InvalidTokenAccount
errors.msg: A token account is not the expected one

errors.name: SwapAccountChanged
errors.msg: A swap-authority token account did not end the sweep as it started

errors.name: SlippageExceeded
errors.msg: The swap returned less than the minimum output

errors.name: PlanChangeRequired
errors.msg: The tier and the payment tokens change through their own instructions

errors.name: PendingIncrease
errors.msg: Pending amounts can only be lowered

errors.name: UserNotPaused
errors.msg: The user is not paused

errors.name: UserNotExited
errors.msg: The user has not exited

types.name: Asset
docs: A tokenized stock the sweep can buy.

fields.name: pyth_feed_id
docs: Pyth Pro feed id of the asset's USD price, quoted per raw token unit.

types.name: Attestation
docs: A transfer the attestor observed, in the payment token's raw units.

fields.name: payment_token
docs: Index into `Config.payment_tokens`.

fields.name: event_time
docs: Block time of the transfer.

fields.name: signature
docs: The transfer's transaction signature.

fields.name: transfer_index
docs: Position of the transfer, from 0 in instruction order (each outer instruction followed by its inner ones),
among the transaction's transfers of either configured payment token to or from the user.

types.name: AttestationRecord
docs: Marks an attested transfer as counted until it expires.

fields.name: payer
docs: Paid the rent and gets it back when the record is closed.

fields.name: expires_at
docs: After this, the transfer can no longer be attested and the record can be closed.

fields.name: invested
docs: What the user's rule adds to `pending`.

types.name: Config
docs: Global settings at `[CONFIG_SEED]`: 865 bytes with the discriminator.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Set by `propose_admin`; `Pubkey::default()` when no handover is pending.

fields.name: paused
docs: Kill switch: when set, enrollment, reactivation and sweeps stop; the users' own controls keep working.

fields.name: router
docs: The only program the sweep may swap through. Set once by `initialize`.

fields.name: attestor
docs: Ed25519 key whose signatures attest incoming and outgoing payments.

fields.name: sponsor
docs: Pays the fees and rent of users' onboarding; `enroll` requires it as payer.

fields.name: user_weekly_cap
docs: Beta cap per user and week, in USD with 6 decimals.

fields.name: max_users
docs: Beta cap on enrolled users; `user_count` is kept by enrollment, reactivation and exit.

fields.name: assets
docs: SPYx first (the default), then QQQx. Set once by `initialize`.

fields.name: payment_tokens
docs: USDC, then USDT. Set once by `initialize`.

fields.name: vault_bump
docs: Bump of the vault authority at `[VAULT_SEED]`.

fields.name: market_calendar
docs: NYSE closures, loaded by the admin as the exchange publishes them; empty until then, so the market counts
as closed.

fields.name: genesis_hash
docs: Genesis hash of the cluster this deployment runs on. Set once by `initialize`; attestations sign it, so they
count only on this cluster.

types.name: ConfigParams
docs: Everything `initialize` sets. The tables and the router never change afterwards: users refer to table entries by
index, and the vault signs the router's instruction.

fields.name: genesis_hash
docs: Genesis hash of the cluster being deployed to, as `getGenesisHash` returns it: the program cannot read it, so
the deployment supplies it and checks it.

fields.name: router
docs: The only program a sweep may swap through.

types.name: EnrollParams
docs: What a user chooses when enrolling; the default is the cleared settings of a user who exited.

types.name: EventKind
docs: Which rule an attested transfer feeds.

types.name: MarketCalendar
docs: The NYSE closures the weekly engine respects, one bit per day: bit `i` of a bitmap (byte `i / 8`, bit `i % 8`)
stands for day `first_day + i`, counted from 1970-01-01.

fields.name: first_day
docs: The day the calendar was loaded.

fields.name: valid_through
docs: The last day the calendar covers; outside `first_day..=valid_through` the market counts as closed.

fields.name: holidays
docs: Full-day closures.

fields.name: early_closes
docs: Days the market closes at 13:00 New York time.

types.name: PaymentToken
docs: A stablecoin users are pulled in.

fields.name: usd_feed_id
docs: Pyth Pro feed id of the token's USD price; 0 when it is priced at one dollar.

types.name: Settings
docs: What the admin can change after initialization.

fields.name: engine
docs: Pulled for the engine and for pending amounts, in the payment token's raw units.

fields.name: asset_price
docs: The asset's verified price, `asset_price × 10^asset_exponent` dollars per 10^decimals raw units: the
display multiplier is included, so a UI token costs this price over the multiplier.

fields.name: received
docs: Raw asset units the user received, and the minimum the prices allowed.

types.name: UserConfig
docs: A user's signed settings and sweep state at `[USER_CONFIG_SEED, user]`: 164 bytes with the discriminator. It is
never closed, so its counters outlive an exit.

fields.name: tier
docs: Index into `TIERS`: the weekly cap across both payment tokens.

fields.name: payment_tokens
docs: Bit `i` set when `Config.payment_tokens[i]` is enabled.

fields.name: asset
docs: Index into `Config.assets`.

fields.name: engine_amount
docs: What the engine invests each day or week, in USD with 6 decimals; 0 turns it off.

fields.name: income_rule
docs: Invest a share of each incoming payment.

fields.name: change_multiplier
docs: Change per outgoing payment: 0 (off) to 3.

fields.name: cushions
docs: Balance left untouched per payment token, in that token's raw units (6 decimals).

fields.name: enrolled_at
docs: Unix time of enrollment; the trial week starts here.

fields.name: goal_amount
docs: Savings goal in USD with 6 decimals.

fields.name: goal_label
docs: UTF-8, zero-padded.

fields.name: week
docs: The week `week_spent` counts, from enrollment (see `week_at`).

fields.name: week_spent
docs: Pulled in `week` across both payment tokens.

fields.name: engine_ran_at
docs: When the engine last bought; before `enrolled_at` when it never has.

fields.name: pending
docs: Variable amounts attested but not yet pulled; carried over until the caps let them through.

fields.name: status
docs: Only an active user is pulled from or credited with attested transfers.

fields.name: attestable_from
docs: Block time of the earliest transfer that can be attested: enrollment, raised to the clock by each return to
`Active` (resume, reactivation) and each enabling of a payment token or rule that was off. Never lowered.

fields.name: last_sweep_day
docs: Per payment token, the UTC day (days since 1970-01-01) of its last sweep; 0 before the first.

types.name: UserStatus
docs: Where a user stands. The account outlives an exit, so a returning user keeps their counters.

constants.name: ATTESTATION_DOMAIN
docs: Prefix of every attested message. The attestor signs it, then the program's address, `Config.genesis_hash` and the
[`Attestation`](crate::Attestation)'s Borsh encoding, so a signature counts only in this deployment.

constants.name: ATTESTATION_SEED
docs: Seed of an [`AttestationRecord`](crate::AttestationRecord), followed by the user's address, the two halves of the
transfer's transaction signature and its transfer index.

constants.name: ATTESTATION_TTL_SECONDS
docs: How long a transfer can be attested after it happened; its record can be closed afterwards.

constants.name: CONFIG_SEED
docs: Seed of the [`Config`](crate::Config) account.

constants.name: SWAP_SEED
docs: Seed of the swap authority: every plan's only destination and the only signer of a sweep's route, so a route
never carries the plan owner's signature.

constants.name: USER_CONFIG_SEED
docs: Seed of a user's [`UserConfig`](crate::UserConfig), followed by the user's address.

constants.name: VAULT_SEED
docs: Seed of the vault authority: it owns every plan and pulls from it as its owner.
